summary: TNL Mediagene (Nasdaq: TNMG) filed a Form 6-K disclosing receipt of a Nasdaq staff delisting determination letter on June 22, 2026. The delisting action is based on the company's ordinary shares closing below $1.00 per share for 30 consecutive business days (May 7–June 18, 2026), violating Listing Rule 5550(a)(2). Because a reverse stock split occurred in the prior year, no compliance period is available under Rule 5810(c)(3)(A)(iv). An additional basis is non-compliance with the $2,500,000 minimum stockholders' equity requirement (Rule 5550(b)(1)). The company intends to request a hearing before a Nasdaq Hearings Panel, which will automatically stay suspension and Form 25-NSE filing pending a decision. There is no certainty of continued listing.
